title: Realtime Recognition Monitoring

steps.expected: Live monitor and camera logs panel are accessible
steps.actual: The /cameras page briefly renders the monitor, but direct navigation later redirects to /overview before the screen is stable

steps.action: Observed camera status and existing recognition logs
steps.expected: Camera stream is LIVE and recent logs are listed
steps.actual: Bridge online, 2 camera streams and 100 camera log records were displayed while the page was mounted

steps.action: Pushed test camera events ADD06RT123, ADD06RT456 and ADD06RT789
steps.expected: New plate scan appears in the monitor instantly
steps.actual: ADD06RT789 did not appear after the panel was already loaded; it appeared only after reloading /cameras, timestamp 18:00:36 16/09/2026

steps.action: Checked the log table for OCR confidence percentage and timestamp
steps.expected: Confidence percentage and trigger timestamp are visible
steps.actual: Timestamp is visible, but the camera log table has no confidence column. The separate /recognition-logs route redirects to /overview, so confidence cannot be verified on screen

limitation: Camera LIVE status and log loading work. The current cameras log panel performs a one-time load and is not subscribed to the camera event stream; it also does not display OCR confidence. The recognition-log screen/route is not reachable from the current navigation flow.
